title: 1871 downtown streets rebuilt to match the period photographs
items: Lake, Clark, State and LaSalle now run unbroken: four- and five-storey fronts, arched windows, iron arcades, mansards and balconies.
The St. James Hotel stands at State and Washington, beside Crosby's Opera House.
McVicker's Theatre stands beside the Tribune, and a long marble front faces the Court House square.
